# pvgis_tmy.csv

Typical Meteorological Year direct normal irradiance (column `Gb(n)`), from the EU JRC PVGIS service (https://re.jrc.ec.europa.eu/pvg_tools/en/), fetched from the PVGIS TMY API for this project's site (lat -10.0, lon -52.0) by the source research code that `heliostat.dni` was ported from; the equivalent call here is `heliostat.dni.fetch("pvgis", cfg)`.
